name: Berri Downstream Pipeline (Abu Ali Island-Khursaniyah-Ju'aymah)

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: Two new lines (30-in stabilized Arabian Light crude + 10-in sour condensate) built 2019-2023 from Aramco's Abu Ali Island processing plant/GOSP to the existing Khursaniyah Gas Plant and Ju'aymah tank farm, installed 'via expanding the existing KRT [Khursaniyah-Ras Tanura] pipeline corridor' (Saipem). Endpoints only -- no traced geometry or total route km found in open sources. Saipem quotes an offshore 'pulling length of over 8 km' for four pipe sections, but that figure is explicitly the marine shore-pull/pipelay crossing (Abu Ali Island landfall), not the full onshore-to-Khursaniyah/Ju'aymah route length, so it is NOT used as LengthKnown. Source does not state which of the two pipes (30-in crude vs 10-in condensate) terminates at which of the two endpoints (Khursaniyah Gas Plant vs Ju'aymah tank farm) -- both endpoints are listed together in the single EndLocation value above rather than paired to a specific diameter, to avoid asserting an unconfirmed pairing.
values.Background: Part of Saudi Aramco's Berri Increment Program, which adds facilities (new GOSP at Abu Ali Island, expanded gas processing at Khursaniyah, water injection, offshore platforms/drilling islands) to raise Berri field crude availability by ~250,000 bpd (250 MBCD) of Arabian Light crude plus associated condensate handling. These two downstream pipelines were built to carry that increment from Abu Ali Island onward to existing Khursaniyah/Ju'aymah infrastructure.

researcher_notes: RE-CHECK vs existing rows done first: full-CSV grep for 'Berri'/'Abu Ali'/'Khursaniyah'/'Kursaniyah'/'Juaymah' across all Saudi Arabia GOIT rows turns up P1970 (Abu Ali-Berri junction), P1978 (Berri junction-Ras Tanura), the Khursaniyah-Ras Tanura/KRT family (P1963/1967/1968/5159), the Safiniyah-Kursaniyah family (P1964/1965/1966/5169), Qatif Junction-Juaymah (P1987/1988/1989) and Safaniyah-Juaymah (P1958) -- none of these start at Abu Ali Island itself and run to Khursaniyah Gas Plant/Ju'aymah tank farm; they are all different corridors (Berri junction, Safiniyah, Qatif Junction, Safaniyah as the other endpoint), confirming the consolidator note that this is genuinely new construction, not a rename/duplicate of P1970/P1978 or the KRT family. Class = new_row. Add-threshold: (a) sponsor -- Saudi Aramco, confirmed by Saipem (client) and independently by nsenergybusiness (Aramco awarded the EPIC contracts); Aramco is an existing entity (entity_lookup.py exact match 'Saudi Aramco', no new entity needed); (b) country+endpoints -- Saudi Arabia, Abu Ali Island processing plant to Khursaniyah Gas Plant and Ju'aymah tank farm, stated directly by Saipem and corroborated (facility locations, not pipeline detail) by Sadeen Group/GCS's subcontract scope 'at Saudi Aramco's existing plants, Khursaniyah and Abu Ali, under the Berri increment program'; (c) concrete step -- EPIC contract award (Saudi Aramco awarded ~$1.3bn EPIC contracts to Saipem in July 2019 as part of 34 contracts/$18bn across the Marjan and Berri increment programs, per nsenergybusiness) followed by completed construction (Saipem: 'When 2019-2023'). All three legs clear. Independent=true: three separately-run sites (Saipem's own corporate project page as primary/contractor source; NS Energy Business, an independent energy trade-press outlet, on the 2019 contract award; Sadeen Group/GCS, an independent Saudi subcontractor, on its Khursaniyah/Abu Ali civil-works scope) agree on sponsor, program and locations -- not one wire story reprinted. Tier=medium: the engineering specifics (30-in/10-in diameters, the two-endpoint routing, the 2019-2023 build window) come from a single primary source (Saipem, the EPC contractor -- a company/project-page source, so filled at medium/yellow per the single-strong-source rule rather than left blank), with the broader program/location/sponsor facts independently corroborated by nsenergybusiness and Sadeen Group. No confirmed total pipeline length was found (the Saipem '8 km' figure is only the offshore shore-pull crossing, not end-to-end) and no route geometry exists, so RouteAccuracy=low/endpoints-only and LengthKnown is left blank rather than guessed. Capacity (250,000 bpd) is the Berri field crude-increment figure the pipelines were purpose-built to carry per Saipem/nsenergybusiness, used as the best available capacity proxy since no separate pipeline-only throughput rating was published -- flagged here as a proxy, not an independently verified nameplate figure. ProjectLevelCost intentionally left blank: the only cost figures found ($1.3bn Saipem EPIC award, $18bn combined Marjan+Berri total) cover contract scope well beyond just these two pipelines, so attributing either number to this pipeline alone would misstate cost.
